title: Ral Zarek | Planeswalker
description: Read Ral Zarek's biography—a mage from Ravnica determined to prove his worth, even in defiance of his guild master.

paragraphs.text: Brilliant, unpredictable, and daring, Ral Zarek was always testing boundaries (and nerves) as a young mage. His bright, fearless skill made him a natural at harnessing the chaotic power of lightning and storms.
